# Tests

- Fake collaborators by subclassing the contract by hand (`MockChannel` in `test/notification_manager_test.dart`, `MockPushDriver` in `test/notification_manager_push_test.dart`): `dev_dependencies` carry no mocking library.
- Call `forgetDrivers()` on `NotificationManager` in every `setUp`: the manager is a `static final` that outlives a container reset, so channels, push factories, the resolved driver, in-flight reads and the in-memory push intent would leak into the next test. It leaves the persisted intent (`NotificationManager.pushIntentKey`) alone on purpose, because a test seam must not sign a real device out.
